title: Measuring Fairness Under Unawareness of Sensitive Attributes: A Quantification-Based Approach
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the development and evaluation of methods to measure algorithmic fairness, a core ethical concept. It addresses how to quantify unjust treatment of different demographic groups, which is a direct engagement with ethics in AI beyond a superficial mention. The work benchmarks different technical approaches for their ability to measure an ethical property (group fairness).
